draw.ev.count: Drawing, "Evidence colors" box: how much is colored for a piece of evidence; {atoms} = number of atoms, {bonds} = number of bonds.
draw.ev.fail: Drawing, "Evidence colors" box: the colors were not applied; {message} = engine error, already translated.
draw.ev.painted: Drawing, "Evidence colors" box, status row: {n} = colored layers, {total} = layers requested.
draw.ev.row: Drawing, row of the color legend: {kind} = type of evidence with its color written out (draw.ev.kind.*), {label} = label given by the page that asks, {what} = count (draw.ev.count) or the reason why there is no color (draw.ev.skip.*).
